_why: Ratchet floors. A gate whose check count can fall silently cannot detect a deleted requirement: stripping four required headings from one pack made validate.py drop 1270->1269 and sloplint.py 224->223, both still green. Each number is the count measured on the commit named below. Raise freely; lowering one needs a reason in the same commit.
_measured_on: the self-contradicting-pack pass (B-022/23/24/33/35/36/38/39/41/44, SG-04) — 2026-08-20, twenty-nine packs and twenty-nine kits, clean tree
_raised: 3398/1912/635 -> 3543/1924/635 on the self-contradicting-pack pass, 2026-08-20. validate.py +145, attributed by running each function in isolation against this tree and against 30bfbc3: +58 validate_elevation_tokens_named (every --shadow-*/--*-glow a pack declares, named in its prose — 58 tokens across 29 packs); +14 validate_motion_bands (a press against the doctrine's band, plus every duration literal in a Components or Micro-interactions section against the pack's own tokens and the UI ceiling); +6 validate_release_register (duplicate CHANGELOG version, the Run stamps table, the missing-tag audit against UNTAGGED_RELEASES, and the declared exception that stopped being one); +6 validate_emphasis_base_layer (a banned weight or slant, per pack that bans one); +59 validate_status_vocabulary (the cross-pack status map in SURFACE_COMPOSITION.md, one existence check and one set-equality check per pack, plus the table-found check — it was prose until this commit and wrong in three places); +2 validate_pack_enumerations, which is the same count as before over one more site — package.json, the description npmjs.com renders. validate_radius_single_valued adds 0 on a clean tree by design: it calls check() only on a component that has two radii, so its floor contribution is zero and its proof is its plant. validate_palette.py +12: +7 validate_line_surface_collision (a line and a surface resolving to one colour, plus every token named in an '@role drawn-on:' list having to exist), +2 validate_pack and +3 validate_stated_ratios from instrument-console gaining --danger and --info, which its prose had legislated since its first release. sloplint.py unchanged, as expected — no colour moved and no lint target was added. Then 3543 -> 3550 on the B-001/B-002 close: +7 from validate_contract_declaration requiring a `Contract: core` line to NAME what it declines (one check per core pack, seven of them). `awning` shipped a bare `Contract: core` and the guard caught it on its first run — a narrow pack and an unfinished pack read identically until the declination is written down. Then 3550 -> 3558 on B-006: +8 from validate_every_surface_class_is_discoverable (one check per enumerated surface class, plus the description-found check). `briefing-room` ships for investor decks and the word `deck` appeared nowhere in the description, so the only phrasing anybody would use for that surface reached nothing. Then validate_palette.py 1924 -> 1951 on the B-013 close: +27 from the five tables that now declare the base their own numbers resolve against — atrium 6, cyclorama 12, router 5, orchard 3, prism 1. Every one of the 27 was already written in the library and none was checked; declaring the base ran the arithmetic over them without changing a single ratio. The same commit pins the coverage itself under `validate_palette.py:ratios`, because a check-count floor cannot see a base being deleted: removing one header moved 27 claims out of the arithmetic while the count of other checks stayed put (watched, 348 -> 342). Then 3558 -> 3560 on the same commit: +2 from `_release_register()` refusing an `[Unreleased]` heading that is not the first section and refusing a second one. 1.45.0's release commit wrote its summary above the accumulated section and left it in place, so the shipped version's detail was labelled unreleased and this entry would have been written on top of published notes. The duplicate-version check could not see it because `Unreleased` is not a version.
_not_raised_by_the_widening: Measured old-pattern-against-new on one tree: the widened separator adds 51 spans across all 1025 text files but only 2 inside the source list validate_counted_claims reads, which is why the floor moves by 2 and not by 51. The rest are in CHANGELOG.md, docs/audit/, docs/evidence/ and test/*.py -- historical narration ('the ten-heading contract', 'a nine-heading pack') plus one branch name, 3 of which the identifier exemption drops. Adding any of those files to the source list means adjudicating each span, not adding a regex escape.

validate_palette.py:ratios._why: Measured on the B-013 close, 2026-08-20: 513 stated ratios — 348 computed, 15 naming a partner this pack cannot pair, 150 reaching no check (0 in a table declaring no base, 10 at a gradient stop, 140 prose). Before it the line said 336 guarded, of which 15 had never been through the arithmetic: the tally was incremented before the pairs were computed. The 27 table claims were closed by declaring the base each table's own numbers resolve against — atrium/router/orchard on `--bg`, cyclorama on `--ink` with four cells naming `--field-2` — every one confirmed by computing it, none of them invented.
